 Mass. country club closing Sunday ahead of housing development plan 
 The redevelopment plan has run into local opposition, with petitions circulating in the city urging its owner, Cesar Ruiz, to keep it as a golf course or sell the property. 
 By Grant Welker | Boston Business Journal • 
 Published October 30, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 30, 2026 at 3:15 pm 
 Wyckoff Country Club in Holyoke is closing amid plans to redevelop the property into housing.
 Wyckoff Country Club in Holyoke will host its last rounds of golf on Sunday, with its owner planning to turn the course into 125 homes.
 The redevelopment plan has run into local opposition, with petitions circulating in the city urging its owner, Cesar Ruiz, to keep it as a golf course or sell the property. But barring an unexpected change, Wyckoff will become the latest Massachusetts golf course to close in recent years.
